items.title: Chester Zardis Interview, 1966-03-09
items.q: And I see one night we played up in Burgalusi... Buddy got... He said come on, drive me to the man.

ctx.x: seen him play no guitar but he was a good banjo player. Buddy made this banjo there. That's the banjo he made himself. You know what I mean? Yeah it's got an unusual head on it. Yeah, head on it. That's right. It's like a guitar head. And that was a good one too. He made it and he was waiting. Every time he'd catch him he was doing something on that banjo. But he was really good at it.
And can you tell us any more about Buddy Patti since he's not here anymore? I never did get to hear him.

What did he sound like? I know it's hard to explain. Buddy was a nice fella. He was an easy going fella. But he had nice ways, you know what I mean, until he'd get that booze. And he used to like to drink plenty. You know what I mean? He was a man that would drink and would take two tree jobs at one time. Well George Lewis told me that once. Well that's the facts you see. And that's what the ruination of the band. But the people used to like him. Buddy did some things there. I think if somebody else would do that…
